name: MiniStore
subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources

releases.localizedDescription:
#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.6.4-20260824.38+9c6a3f0a"
  - revision: "9c6a3f0a"
  - timestamp: "Mon Aug 24 04:48:58 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- Merge pull request #22 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- fix(settings): repaint the merged Minimuxer Backend section with miniStoreCard
- fix(settings): drop the nav bar's background colour so a push has nothing to cross-fade
- Merge branch 'SideStore:develop' into develop
- ensure config changes for rppairing port are reflected asap
- fix compile issues
- optimize: handle onFailure bonjour scan to not be doing timeouts when nw is down or other types of issues.
- make bonjour scan for rppairing port run only on failure as a one time retry per failure.
- wip - implemented bonjour based rppairing port discovery - this is costly eating 4% cpu, so gotta need to only try if a failure occured as a retry and if we detect a port change
- fix all sidejit issues and use bonjour sergices to look up remote server on lan
- fix: restored JIT functionality - tested with remote server on LAN
- freeze anisetteKit to latest
- keep fetch sources timeout to 5 secs
- updated minimuxer to latest
- fix-oda: handle with server's UUID if our current uuid instatiation failed
- recommended sources - reduce timeout to 10 secs, coz let them retry if required
- updated submodule to latest
- feat: added capability to switch between idevice (rust) or limd+remotepair (cpp)
- prepare minimuxer wrapper for adding capability to switch backend (idevice/limd based)
- shared ipa on cold lauch/boot doesn't show install prompt
- fix certificates import with password not having securityScopedAccess
- fix: updated altsign back to use static linking now that minimuxer's device gateways are dynamic to prevent symbol collision during static linking + limd/rsd in cpp based devicegateway
- enable dignostics menu for all
- updated operations to print elapsed time
- added maintenance manager that could be used for performing maintenance (currently clears keychain so that OnDeviceAnisette take work properly - will initiate a fresh sign in)
- ensure signout doesn't crash if db isn't ready
- Revert "disabled ondevice ani flow for now - to not cause trouble to users"

#### Full Changelog: [5119a0e7...9c6a3f0a](https://github.com/The-Big-Mini/MiniStore/compare/5119a0e74891b8e47e04b422914a6de70ef93f52...9c6a3f0ad6cf52a89186d553603a0fa69052c915)

apps.name: MiniStore
apps.subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources
apps.localizedDescription:
MiniStore is SideStore with the interface sanded down.

Everything SideStore does, MiniStore does — it sideloads apps onto your device with just an Apple ID, resigns them with your personal development certificate, and refreshes them in the background so the 7-day development period never expires.

What it adds:

• OLED dark mode — true black throughout, applied live without a relaunch.
• Accent colour theming — presets or a custom colour, across every tab and the home screen widget.
• Reorganised settings — a list of categories instead of one long scroll.
• Tab customization — hide the tabs you don't use and choose which one opens on launch.
• What's New — release notes read straight from GitHub.
• A preloaded catalogue so there is something to browse immediately.

MiniStore is a thin layer on top of SideStore, kept deliberately small so upstream releases can be merged in as they land.
